# Speech Olympiad XIX

> The flagship English-language speech competition of the Gavel Club of the
> University of Moratuwa, Sri Lanka. Tagline: "Rise within. Reign beyond."

Speech Olympiad is an intra-university speech competition open to students of
the University of Moratuwa. It runs in three rounds — Preliminaries, Semi
Finals, and Finals. The nineteenth edition (XIX) is scheduled for 2026.

## Pages

- [Home](https://speecholympiad.com/): Overview, timeline, testimonials, and gallery highlights.
- [About](https://speecholympiad.com/about): What Speech Olympiad is and its history at the University of Moratuwa.
- [Rules & Regulations](https://speecholympiad.com/rules): Eligibility, language, speech rounds, timings, and judging criteria.
- [Technical Tips](https://speecholympiad.com/technical-tips): Public-speaking guidance from past champions and Toastmasters.
- [Champion's Story](https://speecholympiad.com/champions-story): Long-form interviews with previous winners.
- [Blogs](https://speecholympiad.com/blogs): Write-ups of past rounds and events.
- [Gallery](https://speecholympiad.com/gallery): Photographs from previous editions.

## Key dates (Speech Olympiad XIX)

- Preliminary Round: 6th September 2026
- Semi Finals: 20th September 2026
- Finals: 1st October 2026

## Organiser

Gavel Club of the University of Moratuwa, Sri Lanka.
